Aspire.Hosting.Go/Aspire.Hosting.Go.DelveServerOptions # Configures the headless Delve debug server used for remote debugging of a Go application.
  AcceptMultiClient?: boolean # Gets a value indicating whether Delve accepts multiple debugger clients. The default is `false`.
  ContinueOnStart?: boolean # Gets a value indicating whether Delve continues the application immediately after startup. The default is `false`.
  Log?: boolean # Gets a value indicating whether Delve server logging is enabled. The default is `false`.
  LogOutput?: string # Gets the Delve logging components enabled when `Log` is `true`. When `null` or empty, Delve uses its default logging components.
  OnlySameUser?: boolean # Gets a value indicating whether Delve allows connections only from the same operating system user. When `null`, Delve's default same-user policy is used.
  Port?: number # Gets the TCP port on which Delve listens. The default is `2345`.
